questions.q_en: Pipe A takes 4/5 of the time required by pipe B to fill an empty tank individually. When an outlet pipe C is also opened simultaneously with pipes A and B, it takes 4/5 more time to fill the empty tank than it takes when only pipe A and pipe B are opened together. If it takes 40 hours to fill the tank when all the three pipes are opened simultaneously, in what time (in hours) will pipe C empty the full tank, operating alone?
questions.solution_en:
Let time taken by pipe B to fill a tank = 5x hours

So time taken by pipe A = 4x

Now pipe A and B together will fill in 1 hour = 1/4x + 1/5x =9/20x

So they will take 20x/9 to fill a tank.

When C an outlet pipe opens together with A and B it will take =(1+4/5)*(20x/9)=4x

So 4x=40

x=10

Now 1/A + 1/B - 1/C =1/40

9/20x - 1/C = 1/40

Putting x = 10:

9/200 - 1/40 = 1/C

1/C = 4/200

C =50.

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Two points, K and L, are located along the same straight line from the base of a tall building. The distances of these points from the building are 128 meters and 98 meters, respectively. The angles of elevation from these points to the top of the building are complementary. The height of the building is.
questions.solution_en:
Complementary angle = Two angles whose sum is 90 degrees.

Let the angle made by point K be θ.

The angle made by point L = 90° - θ

tan θ = P/B = P/128 [P = perpendicular and B = Base]

tan (90° - θ) = P/98

cot θ = P/98 [tan (90° - θ) = cot θ]

1/tan θ = P/98 [cot θ = 1/tan θ]

1/(P/128) = P/98

128/P = P/98

P2 = 12544

P = 112 m

Hence, the height of the building = 112 m

questions.q_en: Simplify 626 X 2912 ÷ 8138
questions.solution_en:
8138 ÷ 626 = 13

So, the expression becomes:

(626 X 2912) ÷ (626 X 13) = 2912 ÷ 13

Now, 13 X 224 = 2912.

Thus, the simplified value is 224.

questions.q_en: Sum of the lengths of all edges of a cube is 108 cm. A sphere is inscribed into the cube. Find the volume of the inscribed sphere. (Upto two decimals)
questions.solution_en:
Let the side of cube = s cm

Sum of the lengths of all edges of the cube = 108 cm

So, 12 * s = 108

s = 108/12 = 9

We know that,

Diameter of inscribed sphere = side of cube

So, radius of sphere (r) = s/2 = 9/2 cm

Volume of sphere = (4/3) * Π * (r)3

= (4/3) * (22/7) * (9/2)3

= (11 * 81 * 3)/7

= 381.85 cubic cm

questions.q_en:
A and B together can complete a work in 6 hours and 40 minutes, while B alone can complete the work in 12 hours. If they completed work together for Rs.11016, then which of the following statements is/are true?

(P) The share of B is Rs.210 more than Rs.6000.

(Q) The share of B is Rs.120 more than Rs.6000.
questions.solution_en:
The time taken by A and B together to complete the work = 6 hours and 40 minutes = 6(2/3) hours

The time taken by B alone to complete the work = 12 hours

Now,

(1/A) = (3/20) - (1/12) = 1/15

So, the time taken by A alone to complete the work = 15 hours

The ratio of the efficiencies of A and B = 12: 15 = 4: 5

So, the share of B = 11016 X 5/9 = Rs.6120

Hence, only statement Q is true as 6000 + 120 = Rs.6120

questions.q_en: If N = 66 + 69 + 610 + 67, then how many positive factors of N are there?
questions.solution_en:
N = 66 + 69 + 610 + 67

N = 66 * (1 + 63 + 64 + 6)

N = (2 * 3)6 * [(1 + 63) + 6(1 + 63)]

N = 26 * 36 * (1 + 63) * (1 + 6)

N = 26 * 36 * 217 * 7

N = 26 * 36 * 7 * 31 * 7

N = 26 * 36 * 72 * 31

If N = ap * bq * cr [Where a, b and c are prime], then total positive factors of N = (p + 1)(q + 1)(r + 1).

Hence, positive factors of N = (6 + 1) * (6 + 1) * (2 + 1) * (1 + 1) = 7 * 7 * 3 * 2 = 294

questions.q_en: Average of a series of five consecutive numbers is 37. Find the average of the smallest and the second largest number of that series.
questions.solution_en:
Average of a series of five consecutive numbers = 37

Sum of the five consecutive numbers = 37 x 5 = 185

Let the series of 5 consecutive numbers be p, (p + 1), (p + 2), (p + 3) and (p + 4)

According to the question:

=> p + (p + 1) + (p + 2) + (p + 3) + (p + 4) = 185

=> 5p + 10 = 185

=> 5p = 175

=> p = 35

Hence, the series is 35, 36, 37, 38 and 39

Required average of the smallest and the second largest number of that series = (35 + 38)/2 = 36.5

questions.q_en: Find the unit digit in (472)99 + (3185)42.
questions.solution_en:
• (472)99 → last digit 2; cycle of 2 is [2,4,8,6]; 99/4 = 3 (remainder) → 23 = 8

• (3185)42 → last digit 5 → cycle of 5 is always 5

• Unit digit = 8 + 5 = 3

questions.q_en: The median of a set of 15 distinct number is 61. If each of the largest 7 observations of the set is increased by 10, then the median of the new set:
options_en: 15 times that of the original median
Remains the same as that of original set
questions.solution_en:
Total number of observations = 15

So median will be the 8th term.

When the largest 7 observation of the set is increased by 10 then the 7 numbers after the median will increase and median always will be the 8th term.

Therefore, median remains the same as that of original set.
